title: Battle Of Europe
description:
Risk your life in countless dog fights, returning home in a smoking plane full of bullet holes! Whether the next sortie puts you in the seat of a traditional British Spitfire, or behind the throttle of a captured German prototype, the honor of the RAF must be maintained at all costs! You must prove that the RAF is a force to be reckoned with.

Features

• 16 historically based missions

that put you in the pilot seat of

WWII Aircraft.

• 22 different plane models to fly

or destroy.

• Pilot some of Germany’s most secret

and high-tech prototypes.

• Defend Europe from the Axis forces

as they attack from land, sea and air.

• Difficulty levels and a

customizable control scheme

make this a game for all levels

of players.

• Arcade style bonus system

makes every level re-playable.

• 3D graphics and astounding

visual effects make this virtual

battlefield almost too real!

• 8 camera modes, which allow

you to survey the entire

battlefield and see the action

from all angles.
description_short: You must prove that the RAF is a force to be reckoned with!
